transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because things got a bit... out of hand lately. 

I was barely settling into my new apartment, and then I just... I don't know, I suddenly started saying yes to everything. Mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes... I even started redesigning my whole portfolio. It was just... like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Can you describe how you were feeling emotionally during this time when you were taking on so much?

Um... I guess I felt... electric, almost. Just really upbeat. But then... I don't know, it would shift. Like, I snapped at one of the contractors. And my sister. Just over... tiny delays. It felt like they were intentionally trying to block me or slow me down. So... yeah. Upbeat, and then just... irritable, I guess.
During that time when you felt so upbeat and took on a lot, did you find yourself needing less sleep than usual?
Yeah... I suppose. I wasn't sleeping much. Maybe... three or four hours for a few nights there. But I felt fine. I just woke up and... figured I should use the extra time to get ahead.
Was there a period when your mood was elevated or irritable most of the day, nearly every day, that lasted at least a week?
Um... I don't really know if it was a whole week. I didn't exactly track the days. It was just... a few days, maybe. I'm not sure.

Can you think back to that time — was there at least a 4-day period where your mood was clearly different from your usual self, where you felt either unusually high or unusually irritable most of the day, nearly every day?

I mean... yeah, probably. Like I said, this was earlier this month. I'd be feeling really upbeat... electric, like I mentioned... and then I'd just snap at my sister or that contractor over those tiny delays. It really felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done. So... yeah, I guess that went on for at least four days. I just didn't track it.
During that time when your mood was elevated or irritable, did you find yourself more active than usual — like you were constantly driven to do things, or felt restless and unable to sit still?

I suppose... yeah. I just couldn't really sit still. Um... there were nights I was just moving furniture around, or... labeling storage bins. Tweaking mockups for work. I'd just pace through the apartment a lot. It just felt like... I don't know, like stopping was impossible.
During this time when you were feeling so upbeat and active, did you actually feel that you needed less sleep — like you could function well with just a few hours of sleep?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, for a few nights there, I think I only slept... maybe three or four hours. But I didn't really feel tired. I just woke up and... figured I was totally fine. It just seemed like extra time to get ahead on things, so I used it.
During that time when you felt so upbeat and were doing so much, did you also notice yourself talking more than usual, having racing thoughts, feeling overly confident, or getting easily distracted?
I don't really know. I mean, maybe my thoughts were moving fast, but... I was just trying to get my work done. I didn't really pay attention to if I was talking more or... any of that.

Can you confirm if there was a time when, for at least four consecutive days, you felt consistently either unusually high or irritable and also had much more energy or were driven to do a lot more than usual?
Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, those few days I mentioned... it was probably around four days, maybe a bit more. I just... I had a lot of energy and was getting things done. That's about it.
During that time when you felt so upbeat and were doing so much, did you also feel like you had special abilities or were unusually confident in your skills?
Um, no... I don't think so. I didn't think I had any special abilities or anything like that. I was just... doing my design work. I felt fine about it, but... no, nothing unusual.
During that time when your mood was more upbeat or irritable and you were doing a lot, did it cause any problems in your work, relationships, or daily responsibilities?

I mean... I guess it did cause some issues. I actually ended up missing a design review at work. And... I haven't really been talking to my friends or family much lately. I've just been avoiding them because... well, I just feel kind of embarrassed about how scattered and unreliable I've been acting.
After that period of feeling very upbeat and active, did you experience a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yeah... I guess so. It's been a while now. I just... lately I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. It's just there. Even when the apartment is completely quiet and nothing is really wrong, I just... I feel like I could cry over something stupid, like a coffee mug in the sink. It's just... hard.
How long have you been feeling down most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... it's been a while. The heavier stretches, like... feeling really down... they started showing up around the time of my separation. That was about 11 months ago. But it's gotten sharper since I moved recently. So, yeah... almost a year, off and on.
During the time you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, did you also lose interest in activities you usually enjoy, or notice changes in your appetite or weight?

I guess... yeah, I don't really do much anymore. I used to like hiking at Crowders, or... I'd cook, or even just sketch out interface ideas for fun. But now... I don't know. I just kind of look at my hiking gear or my tablet and... I just don't care. There's just no pull to do any of it.

Have you ever had a period of time when you felt so high, full of energy, or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self—and during that time, you didn’t need much sleep, were more active than usual, or your thoughts were racing?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Earlier this month... I just had a few days where I felt... I don't know, almost electric. Really upbeat. But then... it would switch, and I'd just snap. Like, I yelled at a contractor at work, and I got really short with my sister over some tiny delay. It just felt like they were... intentionally getting in my way. So, yeah. I guess I was pretty irritable.
How many days in a row would you say you felt that upbeat, electric mood with lots of energy and irritability — was it at least 7 days in a row, or less than that?
Less than that, I think. Maybe... four or five days? I don't really track it.
Can you confirm if the period of feeling upbeat, irritable, and highly energetic lasted at least four consecutive days without a break?
Um... I guess so. I'm not really sure if it was completely without a break. Like I said, I wasn't really keeping track of it... I just know it was around four or five days.

During that time when you felt so upbeat and irritable, did you also experience three or more of the following: talking more than usual, racing thoughts, being easily distracted, doing more activities than usual, feeling overly confident, or taking more risks?

I don't know... maybe? I was just... doing a lot. Working on some designs late into the night. I guess I was talking a bit more, but... I don't really remember all those other things you mentioned. Just... busy, mostly.

Can you confirm if there was a clear period lasting at least four consecutive days when you felt either unusually upbeat or irritable most of the day, nearly every day, and you also had a distinct and persistent increase in your activity level or energy?

I mean... yeah, I guess. It was probably four days. I just... I had a lot of energy. There were nights I couldn't really sit still. I was... moving furniture around, labeling storage bins, tweaking my design mockups over and over. I was just pacing around the apartment a lot. It just... felt like I couldn't stop.
